missing_claims.evidence: Kit guide and overview have two independent reads. Independent new-source P2 verifies the official Kinnex index ZIP, MAS8 FASTA/XML, SMRT Link guide, multiplexing page and public dataset README; they establish four bcM cores, nine analysis motifs and Iso-Seq cDNA PCR primers. The README-linked PacBio application note has one located read and corroborates topology but not physical oligo arms. These sources do not prove complete physical Kinnex assembly components or absence thereof.

conclusion: Two independent original-source reads now cover the kit guide, overview, Kinnex index FASTA, MAS8 FASTA/XML, SMRT Link guide, multiplexing resource, dataset README and linked application note. The model/page reproduce barcode cores, segmentation reference motifs and example Iso-Seq primers without treating analysis motifs as physical junctions. Full Kinnex orientation-PCR oligos, terminal-adapter arms/end geometry and sequencing-primer site remain unresolved by these sources; no missing-information claim is accepted.
